newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - First Bank System Inc Q2 net down.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - First Bank System Inc Q2 net down.

text.p: NOTE: Year-ago Q2 results after $87.0 million non-recurring gain. Excluding gain, year-ago Q2 income $167.1 million or $1.18 a share primary and $1.17 fully diluted.
Q2 1997 net interest income before provision for credit losses of $39.0 million vs $35.0 million a year ago.
Q2 1996 non-interest income includes $75.0 million termination fee and $65.0 million state income tax refund.
Return on equity before non-recurring items.
(All data above 000s except per share numbers. Return in equity is in percent.)
NOTE: Year-ago six month net income after $103.7 millino after-tax non-recurring gain. Excluding gain, year-ago operating income $327.2 million or $2.31 a share fully diluted.
Six-month 1997 net interest income before provision for credit losses of $76.0 million vs $66.0 million.

Year-ago six-month non-interest income includes $15.0 million securities gain, $190.0 million termination fee, $65.0 million state income tax refund and $45.8 million gain on sale of mortgage banking operations.
